name: servicenow-ai-remediation
summary: Prepares a guarded ServiceNow-approved AI remediation demonstration for a Fleet HTTP service outage.

lifecycle.idempotency: Revalidates the checked-in demonstration assets without opening incidents, starting activations, or changing hosts.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before external configuration when the operator has not explicitly opted in or local AAP/EDA prerequisites are unavailable.

rulebooks: HTTP service outage to approval workflow

readiness: The operator reviews and imports the assets into an owned private Gitea repository.
A ServiceNow approval is required before the recovery job is launched.

security.secret_storage: ServiceNow URL, username, and password belong only in aap_demo.servicenow.* encrypted Vault entries and an AAP custom credential; never in Gitea, a profile, an AO variable, or an event.
security.network_trust: ServiceNow API and source-control calls must retain certificate validation; this demo forbids insecure TLS bypasses.
security.external_actions: Prepare is local-only. A human ServiceNow approval, an allow-listed playbook, an exact Fleet target, post-remediation verification, and a bounded attempt count are mandatory before a host can change.
